_comment_turn_timeout: Seconds one agent turn may run before it is killed. Omit for 30 minutes; -1 for no limit. A build or a test suite legitimately runs long, and cancel already exists for a turn that has genuinely hung.
_comment_king: The supervisor is provisioned, not configured — it gets a folder of its own under the data dir. Override its name, tool or dir here if you want to. Its name is reserved: a project may not claim it.
_comment_autonomous: autonomous lets the supervisor start a turn nobody asked for, when a project finishes or gets stuck. Off by default: it is the only thing here that spends money while nobody is watching. wakes_per_hour bounds how often it may start (default 4, capped at 30) and is separate from rounds, which bounds how far it may go once started. Every wake writes a line into the supervisor's thread naming what woke it.
_comment_groups: Optional. Split the fleet between several supervisors, one per tab. A supervisor's context is rebuilt from its fleet on every turn, so six projects means six status lines on every message; two supervisors over three each are cheaper and sharper. Each group gets its own provisioned supervisor named supervisor-<group>. A project not named by any group joins the first one. Omit this entirely for a single supervisor over everything.
